senses.en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure
a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number

ex.en: The scratch made an infinitesimal difference to the table's appearance.
ex.zh: 这道划痕对桌子外观的影响微乎其微。

ex.en: Even infinitesimal changes in ocean temperature can become significant when measured across vast areas over decades.
ex.zh: 即使海水温度变化极其微小，若在广阔海域持续数十年，也可能产生显著影响。

tip: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

senses.en: A funny imitation of a work or style.

ex.en: The film is a parody of spy movies.
ex.zh: 这部电影是对间谍片的戏仿。

senses.en: A comic show that mocks serious subjects.

ex.en: Burlesque theaters were popular in the 1900s.
ex.zh: 滑稽剧院在20世纪初很流行。

senses.en: A play with exaggerated emotions; overly dramatic behavior.

ex.en: The film slides into melodrama.
ex.zh: 这部电影流于煽情。

senses.en: A speech in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud alone.

ex.en: Hamlet's soliloquy begins 'To be or not to be'.
ex.zh: 哈姆雷特的独白以“生存还是毁灭”开头。

senses.en: The main character in a story; a leading supporter of an idea.

ex.en: The protagonist must choose between love and duty.
ex.zh: 主人公必须在爱情和责任之间抉择。

senses.en: An introduction to a play, book or event.

ex.en: The prologue sets the scene.
ex.zh: 序幕交代了背景。

senses.en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole

ex.en: Our tutor used componential analysis to compare similar words.
ex.zh: 我们的老师用成分分析法比较近义词。

ex.en: In linguistics, componential analysis examines word meanings by breaking them down into smaller, shared semantic features.
ex.zh: 在语言学中，成分分析通过将词义分解为较小的共有语义特征来研究词义。

tip: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

senses.en: A section at the end of a book or play.

ex.en: The epilogue tells what happened years later.
ex.zh: 尾声讲述了多年后发生的事。

senses.en: The final part of a story where everything is resolved.

ex.en: The denouement reveals the killer.
ex.zh: 结局揭露了凶手。

senses.en: The part of a stage in front of the curtain, framed by an arch.

ex.en: The actors bowed under the proscenium arch.
ex.zh: 演员们在台口拱门下鞠躬。

senses.en: Behind the stage in a theater.

ex.en: Fans waited backstage for autographs.
ex.zh: 粉丝们在后台等着要签名。

senses.en: A row of lights along the front of a stage.

ex.en: She stepped into the glow of the footlights.
ex.zh: 她走进了脚灯的光晕里。

senses.en: Public attention.

ex.en: The young actor enjoyed the limelight.
ex.zh: 这位年轻演员享受着众人的瞩目。

senses.en: thick and sticky, flowing slowly

ex.en: Honey is more viscous than water.
ex.zh: 蜂蜜比水黏稠。

ex.en: Volcanoes with viscous lava tend to erupt explosively because gas cannot escape easily.
ex.zh: 熔岩黏稠的火山往往爆炸式喷发，因为气体不易逸出。

tip: 火山喷发类型话题常见。

senses.en: A theater company performing several plays in turn.

ex.en: She started her career in repertory theater.
ex.zh: 她从轮演剧团开始了职业生涯。

senses.en: An actor who learns a part to replace the main actor if needed.

ex.en: The understudy went on when the star fell ill.
ex.zh: 主角生病时替角上了场。

senses.en: A person who designs dance steps.

ex.en: The choreographer worked with the dancers for weeks.
ex.zh: 编舞和舞者们一起排练了几周。

senses.en: The art of designing dances.

ex.en: The ballet's choreography was praised.
ex.zh: 这部芭蕾的编舞广受好评。

senses.en: A female ballet dancer.

ex.en: The ballerina spun on her toes.
ex.zh: 芭蕾舞女演员踮着脚尖旋转。

senses.en: A spin on one foot in ballet.

ex.en: She performed a perfect pirouette.
ex.zh: 她完成了一个完美的足尖旋转。

senses.en: A group of performers who travel together.

ex.en: A dance troupe toured the country.
ex.zh: 一个舞蹈团在全国巡演。

senses.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

ex.en: The contract says we must pay the aforesaid fee.
ex.zh: 合同规定我们必须支付上述费用。

ex.en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
ex.zh: 必须满足上述条件，地方议会才能批准保护区内的任何建设项目。

tip: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

senses.en: Acting with gestures and no words.

ex.en: The mime pretended to be trapped in a box.
ex.zh: 哑剧演员假装被困在箱子里。

senses.en: A play performed with gestures; a British Christmas comedy show.

ex.en: Children love the Christmas pantomime.
ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢圣诞童话剧。

senses.en: The art of working puppets.

ex.en: Shadow puppetry has a long history in China.
ex.zh: 皮影戏在中国历史悠久。

senses.en: A puppet moved by strings.

ex.en: The marionette danced on its strings.
ex.zh: 提线木偶随着线舞动。

senses.en: A variety show of songs, comedy and acts.

ex.en: Many film stars began in vaudeville.
ex.zh: 许多电影明星起步于杂耍剧场。

senses.en: Entertainment with music and dancing in a nightclub.

ex.en: She sang in a Berlin cabaret.
ex.zh: 她在柏林的一家歌舞厅唱歌。

senses.en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.
To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.

ex.en: The coach apologised for his profane language after the match.
ex.zh: 教练为赛后说的粗话道了歉。

ex.en: Museums should explain why objects considered ordinary by outsiders may be sacred, making careless treatment seem profane.
ex.zh: 博物馆应解释为何外人眼中的普通物品可能是神圣之物，以致随意对待会显得亵渎。

col: profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

senses.en: The art of filming movies.

ex.en: The film won an award for cinematography.
ex.zh: 这部电影获得了最佳摄影奖。

senses.en: The person in charge of filming a movie.

ex.en: The cinematographer used natural light.
ex.zh: 电影摄影师使用了自然光。

senses.en: The script of a film.

ex.en: She wrote the screenplay in three months.
ex.zh: 她用三个月写完了电影剧本。

senses.en: A person who writes screenplays.

ex.en: The screenwriter adapted the novel.
ex.zh: 编剧改编了这部小说。

senses.en: A sequence of short shots edited together.

ex.en: A montage shows the hero training.
ex.zh: 一段蒙太奇展示了主人公的训练。

senses.en: A person who makes animated films.

ex.en: Animators drew thousands of frames.
ex.zh: 动画师画了成千上万帧。

senses.en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle

ex.en: The doctor showed me my tibia on the scan.
ex.zh: 医生在扫描影像上指给我看我的胫骨。

ex.en: A fracture of the tibia may require several months of rehabilitation before an athlete can safely resume training.
ex.zh: 胫骨骨折可能需要数月康复，运动员才能安全恢复训练。

col: the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨

senses.en: A series of drawings planning the shots of a film.

ex.en: The director sketched a storyboard.
ex.zh: 导演画了分镜脚本。

senses.en: A short novel.

ex.en: Kafka's The Metamorphosis is a novella.
ex.zh: 卡夫卡的《变形记》是一部中篇小说。

senses.en: A collection of poems or stories by different writers.

ex.en: The anthology includes fifty poets.
ex.zh: 这本选集收录了五十位诗人的作品。

senses.en: A group of lines in a poem.

ex.en: The poem has four stanzas.
ex.zh: 这首诗有四个诗节。

senses.en: Two lines of poetry that rhyme.

ex.en: Each sonnet ends with a couplet.
ex.zh: 每首十四行诗都以对句结尾。

senses.en: A stanza of four lines.

ex.en: The poem is written in quatrains.
ex.zh: 这首诗由四行诗节组成。

senses.en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition

ex.en: Her vehement refusal surprised everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 她激烈的拒绝让桌旁的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: The proposed closure of the community library met with vehement opposition from residents and local educators.
ex.zh: 关闭社区图书馆的提议遭到了居民和当地教育工作者的强烈反对。

tip: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

senses.en: Having a rhythm of an unstressed syllable followed by a stressed one.

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote in iambic pentameter.
ex.zh: 莎士比亚用抑扬格五音步写作。

senses.en: Repeating the same first sound in nearby words.

ex.en: 'Peter Piper picked' uses alliteration.
ex.zh: “Peter Piper picked”用了头韵。

senses.en: Repeating vowel sounds in nearby words.

ex.en: Assonance gives the line a musical feel.
ex.zh: 谐元韵使诗句富有音乐感。

senses.en: Comparing two things using 'like' or 'as'.

ex.en: 'As brave as a lion' is a simile.
ex.zh: “像狮子一样勇敢”是明喻。

senses.en: Giving human qualities to things; a perfect example of a quality.

ex.en: 'The wind whispered' is personification.
ex.zh: “风在低语”是拟人。

senses.en: Descriptive language that creates pictures in the mind.

ex.en: The poem's imagery is vivid.
ex.zh: 这首诗的意象生动。

senses.en: Unpleasantly loud and harsh in sound.

ex.en: Raucous laughter from the kitchen woke the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 厨房里传来刺耳的大笑声，吵醒了熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Residents argue that raucous nightlife disrupts sleep and reduces the appeal of otherwise attractive urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 居民认为，喧闹的夜生活扰乱睡眠，也降低了原本宜居的城市街区的吸引力。

tip: 强调声音粗哑刺耳或喧闹，不只是嗓音沙哑。

senses.en: Meaning the opposite of what is said; strangely the opposite of what is expected.

ex.en: It is ironic that the fire station burned down.
ex.zh: 消防站被烧毁真是讽刺。

senses.en: Exaggeration for effect.

ex.en: 'I've told you a million times' is hyperbole.
ex.zh: “我跟你说过一百万次了”是夸张。

senses.en: Saying something is less important than it is.

ex.en: Calling the storm 'a bit windy' was an understatement.
ex.zh: 把那场风暴说成“有点风”太轻描淡写了。

senses.en: Knowing everything.

ex.en: An omniscient narrator knows every character's thoughts.
ex.zh: 全知叙述者知道每个人物的想法。

senses.en: Writing about real facts and events.

ex.en: She prefers nonfiction to novels.
ex.zh: 比起小说她更喜欢非虚构作品。

senses.en: A written account of one's own life and experiences.

ex.en: The general wrote a memoir of the war.
ex.zh: 将军写了一本战争回忆录。

senses.en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it

ex.en: The opal in her ring flashed green and blue.
ex.zh: 她戒指上的欧泊闪着绿色和蓝色的光。

ex.en: Opal mining can provide employment in remote regions, although it may also disturb fragile desert environments.
ex.zh: 欧泊开采能为偏远地区提供就业，但也可能破坏脆弱的沙漠环境。

tip: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

senses.en: A person honored for achievement, such as a Nobel laureate or poet laureate.

ex.en: The Nobel laureate gave a lecture.
ex.zh: 这位诺贝尔奖得主做了一场讲座。

senses.en: The words of a song; expressing personal feelings.

ex.en: She wrote the lyrics for the song.
ex.zh: 她为这首歌写了歌词。

senses.en: Expressing emotion in a beautiful way.

ex.en: The film has a lyrical quality.
ex.zh: 这部电影富有抒情色彩。

senses.en: A poem praising someone or something.

ex.en: Keats wrote an ode to a nightingale.
ex.zh: 济慈写了一首《夜莺颂》。

senses.en: A sad poem, often about someone who has died.

ex.en: He wrote an elegy for his friend.
ex.zh: 他为朋友写了一首挽歌。

senses.en: A long story of heroic deeds, or a long series of events.

ex.en: The Icelandic sagas tell of Viking families.
ex.zh: 冰岛萨迦讲述了维京家族的故事。

senses.en: having many different kinds or aspects

ex.en: The market's multifarious offerings included spices, pottery, and handmade toys.
ex.zh: 市场上的商品五花八门，包括香料、陶器和手工玩具。

ex.en: Urban planners must consider the multifarious needs of residents when designing accessible and inclusive public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市规划者设计便利且包容的公共空间时，必须考虑居民多种多样的需求。

tip: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

senses.en: A short story, often with animals, that teaches a moral.

ex.en: Aesop's fables teach simple lessons.
ex.zh: 伊索寓言讲述简单的道理。

senses.en: A simple story used to teach a moral or religious lesson.

ex.en: The parable teaches forgiveness.
ex.zh: 这则寓言教人宽恕。

senses.en: An outstanding piece of work.

ex.en: The cathedral is a gothic masterwork.
ex.zh: 这座大教堂是哥特式杰作。

senses.en: All the works of an artist or writer.

ex.en: The film is a key part of his oeuvre.
ex.zh: 这部电影是他作品中的重要一部。

senses.en: A list of works seen as the most important; a rule.

ex.en: Hamlet is central to the Western canon.
ex.zh: 《哈姆雷特》是西方经典的核心。

senses.en: Relating to or like pantomime.

ex.en: His pantomimic gestures made the children laugh.
ex.zh: 他哑剧般的动作逗得孩子们大笑。

senses.en: A star that suddenly becomes much brighter for a short time.

ex.en: Ancient astronomers recorded a nova as a 'guest star'.
ex.zh: 古代天文学家把新星记作“客星”。

senses.en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out
Providing the force that moves something forward

ex.en: This spray can uses compressed air as its propellent.
ex.zh: 这个喷雾罐用压缩空气作喷射剂。

ex.en: Developing cleaner rocket propellents could reduce the environmental impact of the growing commercial space industry.
ex.zh: 开发更清洁的火箭推进剂有望减少不断发展的商业航天业对环境的影响。

tip: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

senses.en: A rapidly spinning neutron star that sends out regular pulses of radiation.

ex.en: The first pulsar was mistaken for a signal from aliens.
ex.zh: 第一颗脉冲星曾被误认为外星人的信号。

senses.en: An extremely bright and distant object powered by a black hole.

ex.en: Quasars are among the most distant objects we can see.
ex.zh: 类星体是我们能看到的最遥远的天体之一。

senses.en: An instrument that splits light into a spectrum for study.

ex.en: With a spectroscope, scientists found helium in the sun.
ex.zh: 科学家用分光镜在太阳中发现了氦。

senses.en: A layer of the upper atmosphere that contains many charged particles.

ex.en: Radio waves bounce off the ionosphere.
ex.zh: 无线电波会被电离层反射。

senses.en: The region around a planet controlled by its magnetic field.

ex.en: Earth's magnetosphere shields us from the solar wind.
ex.zh: 地球的磁层为我们挡住太阳风。

senses.en: A shift of light toward longer wavelengths, showing an object is moving away.

ex.en: The redshift of distant galaxies shows the universe is expanding.
ex.zh: 遥远星系的红移表明宇宙在膨胀。

senses.en: relating to farming and land

ex.en: The region was mostly agrarian a century ago.
ex.zh: 一百年前，这个地区主要以农业为主。

ex.en: The shift from a hunting-based to an agrarian economy allowed populations to settle in permanent villages.
ex.zh: 从狩猎经济转向农业经济，使人们得以定居在永久村落中。

tip: 历史类文章常对比 agrarian society 与 industrial society。

senses.en: The point in the sky directly above an observer.

ex.en: At noon the sun nearly reached its zenith.
ex.zh: 正午时太阳几乎到达天顶。

senses.en: An imaginary line passing through the poles and a given place.

ex.en: A star crosses the meridian once every night.
ex.zh: 一颗星每晚穿过子午线一次。

senses.en: The gradual growth of something as new layers are added.

ex.en: Planets grew by accretion of dust and rock.
ex.zh: 行星通过吸积尘埃和岩石而长大。

senses.en: To come together to form one larger whole.

ex.en: Gas clouds coalesce to form new stars.
ex.zh: 气体云聚合形成新的恒星。

senses.en: The total amount of light a star gives off.

ex.en: A star's luminosity depends on its size and temperature.
ex.zh: 恒星的光度取决于其大小和温度。

senses.en: Existing between galaxies.

ex.en: Intergalactic space is almost completely empty.
ex.zh: 星系之间的空间几乎完全是空的。

senses.en: Unwilling to do something.

ex.en: I was loath to leave the warm kitchen.
ex.zh: 我舍不得离开温暖的厨房。

ex.en: Many residents are loath to support redevelopment projects that could destroy the character of their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 许多居民不愿支持可能破坏社区特色的重建项目。

col: be loath to admit｜不愿承认
be loath to leave｜不愿离开
be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

senses.en: Having the sun at the center.

ex.en: Copernicus proposed a heliocentric model of the solar system.
ex.zh: 哥白尼提出了日心说模型。

senses.en: Having the Earth at the center.

ex.en: The geocentric view placed Earth at the middle of everything.
ex.zh: 地心说把地球放在万物的中心。

senses.en: Moving backward, or in the opposite direction to most objects.

ex.en: Mars appears to move in retrograde for a few weeks.
ex.zh: 火星会有几周看起来在逆行。

senses.en: The apparent shift of an object when seen from two different places.

ex.en: Astronomers measure parallax to find the distance to nearby stars.
ex.zh: 天文学家测量视差来求出近邻恒星的距离。

senses.en: The slow wobble of a spinning object's axis.

ex.en: Precession slowly changes which star is the pole star.
ex.zh: 岁差慢慢改变哪颗星是北极星。

senses.en: The point in an orbit where an object is closest to the sun.

ex.en: The comet brightened as it neared perihelion.
ex.zh: 彗星接近近日点时变亮了。

senses.en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.

ex.en: A new phone is no panacea for your troubles.
ex.zh: 换部新手机并不能解决你所有的烦恼。

ex.en: Although technology can improve classroom learning, it should not be regarded as a panacea for educational inequality.
ex.zh: 虽然技术可以改善课堂学习，但不应被视为解决教育不平等的万全之策。

col: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策
a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

senses.en: The point in an orbit where an object is farthest from the sun.

ex.en: Earth reaches aphelion in early July.
ex.zh: 地球在七月初到达远日点。

senses.en: The apparent path of the sun across the sky over a year.

ex.en: The planets all stay close to the ecliptic.
ex.zh: 行星都靠近黄道运行。

senses.en: The angular distance of a star north or south of the celestial equator.

ex.en: Polaris has a declination of almost 90 degrees.
ex.zh: 北极星的赤纬接近90度。

senses.en: An old instrument used to measure the position of stars.

ex.en: Sailors used the astrolabe to find their latitude.
ex.zh: 水手用星盘确定纬度。

senses.en: An instrument for measuring angles between stars and the horizon.

ex.en: With a sextant, the navigator fixed the ship's position.
ex.zh: 领航员用六分仪确定了船的位置。

senses.en: The opening that lets light into a telescope or camera.

ex.en: A larger aperture lets a telescope see fainter stars.
ex.zh: 更大的孔径让望远镜看到更暗的星。
